name: components_family_heat
source:
// Domain family: HEAT (heat.frees). Across T, flow Qdot; a connect node
// equates every T and sums every Qdot to zero.
// 1000 W/K conduction in series with 5 W/K convection, 400 K to 300 K.
ThermalSource HOT(T = 400)
Conduction    CD(k = 50, area = 0.2, L = 0.01)
Convection    CV(htc = 25, area = 0.2)
ThermalSource COLD(T = 300)
ThermalSensor TS()
connect(HOT.port, CD.a)
connect(CD.b, CV.a, TS.port)
connect(CV.b, COLD.port)
q_wall = CD.Q
t_mid  = TS.T_meas

// control.frees ships exactly one component, the PI thermostat, and it belongs
// to this bond. It declares der(integ), so with no DYNAMIC block the engine
// solves the steady operating point: der -> 0 makes the error zero, which is
// the statement that the controlled node sits at Tref.
ThermalSource SRC2(T = 350)
Conduction    CD2(k = 10, area = 0.1, L = 0.02)
PIThermostat  PI(Kp = 20, Ki = 5, Tref = 310)
connect(SRC2.port, CD2.a)
connect(CD2.b, PI.port)
t_ctrl = PI.port.T
q_ctrl = PI.port.Qdot
